objective: 在纯P1-D1、fixed-draining、固定Mooncake/RDMA传输语义下，用真实SGLang GPU KV发送记录验证拓扑无关P→D 12-bin逻辑消息直方图口径，并建立可由完整请求窗口离线生成的scheduler-faithful Hfull teacher基础闭环
execution_model: one local model copy loaded independently by one single-GPU prefill server and one single-GPU decode server; one router; an isolated compatibility smoke must prove the pinned FlashInfer page-size-1 path, one real Mooncake P-to-D transfer and two exact atomic multi-request admissions before any formal raw is written; each BatchTokenizedGenerateReqInput is held in the prefill bootstrap queue until every request in that fixed-draining wave completes bootstrap, then released in original order; five frozen input_ids batches repeated three times; one scalar rid prefix per batch is deterministically expanded by SGLang; deterministic CPU teacher and exact alignment after GPU release

research_scope.predictor_output: topology-independent 12-bin sender-counted logical KV-chunk calls and logical bytes per 1000 requests
research_scope.teacher_input: complete ordered request list for offline label generation only
research_scope.future_predictor_input: low-dimensional history profile, model KV structure, fixed P strategy, fixed D strategy and fixed transfer policy

backend_contract.attention_backend_reason: the frozen one-token KV page contract requires a backend that preserves explicit page_size=1 on B200; trtllm_mha silently snaps it to 64
backend_contract.logical_message_unit: one post-TP/CP-filter CommonKVSender.send KV chunk for one request
backend_contract.logical_bytes_unit: kv_page_count times the sum of per-page K/V bytes across all local layers, plus state bytes if any

official_model_download.permission_scope: model acquisition before preflight only; formal preflight and GPU execution must set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
official_model_download.download_destination: a persistent compute-node-visible directory outside Git, raw directories, caches owned by other users and protected experiment assets

measurement_contract.arrival_semantics: fixed-draining wave; the next wave is submitted only after the prior wave fully returns
measurement_contract.wave_admission_semantics: one atomic BatchTokenizedGenerateReqInput; prefill bootstrap batch barrier waits for all requests in the current wave, then releases the whole wave in original order
measurement_contract.batch_rid_protocol: submit one scalar rid prefix per input_ids batch; SGLang must expand it to <prefix>_<zero_based_batch_index>
measurement_contract.python_source_contract: repo_root/python must be the first PYTHONPATH entry for preflight and run; sglang_router and mooncake may remain container packages but their locations are recorded
measurement_contract.required_gpu_layout: two distinct GPUs on one host; topology recorded but not used for a placement claim
measurement_contract.raw_storage: profiler JSONL and full P/D/router logs remain outside Git; Git stores only hashes, counts, exact-alignment tables and aggregate 12-bin histograms

compatibility_smoke_contract.storage: a fresh external directory distinct from formal raw and Git
compatibility_smoke_contract.retry_boundary: a failed smoke preserves its external logs/profile; a new smoke directory and, if GPU pair or HCA changes, a new matching preflight audit are required

workload_scenarios.name: single_cross_chunk
workload_scenarios.purpose: one-token continuation beyond the chunk boundary

workload_scenarios.name: packed_remainder
workload_scenarios.purpose: FCFS batch remainder splits the last request

workload_scenarios.name: mixed_burst
workload_scenarios.purpose: mixed short/medium/long requests and repeated chunk continuation

claim_boundary: PASS proves the frozen P1-D1 atomic-fixed-draining/FlashInfer-page-size-1/Mooncake logical-byte and chunk-call teacher matches representative SGLang GPU execution exactly
Phase40 is a semantic and teacher foundation, not a trained low-dimensional PD predictor and not a six-model generalization result
The logical histogram is topology independent; Phase40 does not establish a physical Mooncake cost curve

The conclusion applies to official Qwen/Qwen3-8B revision b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218, the frozen non-MLA model contract, FCFS fixed-draining policy, disabled caches/overlap and exact source commit
Full request lists remain offline teacher inputs and are not authorized as deployed predictor inputs
stop_and_block_if: the exact workflow commit is not checked out or tracked files are dirty
the pinned official Qwen/Qwen3-8B revision cannot be downloaded before preflight or its config, index or five weight-shard hashes differ
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 are not set for formal preflight and GPU execution
repo_root/python is not the first PYTHONPATH entry or sglang does not resolve from the pinned repository source
the router rejects a scalar wave rid prefix or SGLang does not expand it to the frozen <prefix>_<batch_index> request IDs
FlashInfer is unavailable, explicit --attention-backend flashinfer is rejected, or runtime page_size differs from 1
the bootstrap batch barrier is not enabled, optimistic prefill retries are nonzero, or the batched input_ids path is not dispatched atomically
the isolated compatibility smoke does not complete exactly one real Mooncake P-to-D sender chunk and two exact multi-request admission probes before formal raw
two distinct CUDA GPUs, Mooncake, RDMA or the SGLang router are unavailable
execution would require TP/PP greater than one, a backend fallback, staging, radix cache, overlap or changed chunk policy
the model formula, source SHA, request count, per-request chunks, aggregate histograms or repeat determinism differ
raw trace, logs, model weights, cache, PID or protected data would enter Git
